name: Checkboxes
summary: Use checkboxes when users can select any number of options from a visible set, including none when allowed.
whenToUse: Use when zero, one or several answers may be valid and the options can be shown together.
Use a divider and explicit exclusive “None” option only when users must state that no listed choice applies.
whenNotToUse: Use radios or a select when exactly one answer is required.
Do not use checkboxes for acceptance of hidden terms or to trigger immediate navigation.

anatomy.name: Fieldset and legend
anatomy.description: A fieldset groups the question and every checkbox.

anatomy.name: Checkbox group
anatomy.description: A govuk-checkboxes container carries the enhancement hook.

anatomy.name: Checkbox items
anatomy.description: Each native input has a unique ID, shared name where appropriate, value and associated label.

anatomy.name: Conditional content
anatomy.description: A checkbox may control a uniquely identified conditional region through the official module.

variants.name: Small
variants.use: A compact expert interface after confirming smaller controls remain usable.

variants.name: Conditional reveal
variants.use: Reveal a small follow-up field directly related to a selected answer.

behaviour: Initialise govuk-checkboxes when using conditional content or exclusive options.
Without JavaScript, conditional content remains available and the server validates whether it is required.
Do not conditionally reveal another set of checkboxes or complex content; take users to a new page instead.
Retain checked values after validation errors.
accessibility: Use native checkbox inputs inside a fieldset with a visible legend.
Associate every label, hint, error and conditional region using unique IDs and official attributes.
Never make a preselected checkbox the default unless it represents a genuine, non-coercive default.
content: Make it clear that users can select all that apply.
Write options as distinct, concise answers that make sense with the legend.
Use positive wording and avoid overlapping options.
